description: This file contains unit tests for the Azure Queue Stream Provider configuration builder in an Orleans-based project. It verifies various configuration scenarios, including missing connection strings, minimal setup, and full configurations with all options.

classes.name: AzureQueueStreamProviderBuilderTests
classes.description: Test class containing unit tests for Azure Queue Stream Provider builder configuration scenarios.

methods.name: Missing_ConnectionString
methods.description: Tests the behavior when the connection string is missing, expecting a null QueueServiceClient.

methods.name: Minimal_Configuration
methods.description: Verifies that minimal configuration creates a valid QueueServiceClient with default settings.

methods.name: Full_Configuration
methods.description: Checks that all configuration options are correctly parsed and applied.

methods.name: ConfigureSilo
methods.description: Helper method to set up a test silo with specified configuration JSON.

methods.name: GetConfig
methods.description: Creates an IConfigurationRoot object from the provided JSON string.
